_disclaimer: RESEARCH FINDINGS, NOT LEGAL ADVICE. License strings are transcribed from OpenStax's own machine-readable metadata; they are not a legal opinion on permitted use.

method.catalog_source: OpenStax Wagtail CMS REST API, type=books.Book (fully machine-readable; no HTML scraping needed for the catalog)
method.coverage: COMPLETE for the catalog the API exposes: meta.total_count=129, items returned=129 (100%).
method.second_independent_source: OpenStax REX content archive. Per-book version pins read from https://openstax.org/rex/release.json (archiveUrl=/apps/archive/20260604.144757, 127 book pins), then GET {archive}/contents/{book_uuid}@{defaultVersion}.json and read the top-level `license` object.
method.why_two_sources: The CMS `license_name` field is the publisher's catalog claim. The archive `license` object is what actually ships inside the book content. Reading both makes each a check on the other rather than a single unverified assertion.
method.cross_check_result: 116 books had a license from BOTH sources. Agreements: 116. Disagreements: 0.
method.detail_pages_not_scraped: openstax.org/details/books/<slug> is a JavaScript shell (~12 KB, no license string in the served HTML). The CMS API backing those pages was used instead - it is the same data source the page renders from.
method.verified_vs_inferred: VERIFIED: every cc_variant below is transcribed from a license_url returned by one or both OpenStax APIs. INFERRED: nothing. The single unresolved row is reported as null, not guessed.

totals.non_cc_note: ZERO books carry a non-CC license. The owner's premise in DATASET-DESIGN-reservoir.md §7 item 2 ('OpenStax is Creative Commons throughout') is CONFIRMED for all 128 resolvable books.

caveats: The 4 book_state values are NOT interchangeable: live=84, retired=34, unlisted=8, deprecated=3. Only `live` is the current public catalog. Filter on book_state before treating this as an ingest list.

CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 DOMINATES the live catalog (73 of 84 = 86.9%). The commercially-clean CC BY subset is only 11 live books. A future commercial question therefore removes most of OpenStax, not a fringe.

8 Polish-language books report the license via the localized CC deed URL (.../licenses/by/4.0/deed.pl) in the archive while the CMS reports plain CC BY 4.0. Same license, localized deed page; normalized to CC BY 4.0. All 8 are book_state=unlisted.

1 unresolved row: 'College Physics with Courseware' (retired). It is an EMPTY CMS STUB - book_uuid=null, cnx_id=null, webview_link='', license_name=null. There is no content behind it, so there is nothing to license and nothing to ingest. It is not evidence of a non-CC book.
OpenStax states CC BY-NC-SA books may contain third-party material under separate terms; per-book variant does not resolve embedded-asset rights.
'is_non_commercial_only' is derived mechanically from the presence of the NC clause in the license URL. It is a routing hint for queries, not a legal conclusion.
